claim.value: Complete histories do not prove that reporting is truthful.
claim.scope: An evidential limit of documentary completeness.

provenance.rationale: P021 directly states the identified limit.

signal_basis.value: An internally consistent history connects account creation through publication, distinguishing reported offline activity from logged events and labeling retrospective reports and unknowns.
signal_basis.scope: Proposed observations for a bounded cohort of new accounts, assumed to occur for this warrant judgment.

provenance.rationale: The cited bundle supplies the continuity signal, treatment of customer reports, bounded cohort and proposed-observation qualifier.
The supported evidential limit requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Completeness and internal consistency concern the recorded history. A complete, consistent history can still contain false reports, so the assumed signal does not establish reporting truthfulness. The claim correctly states that limit.
uncertainty: Whether particular reports are truthful remains unknown; that does not undermine the stated evidential limit.
